title: Deductibles and Recovery Rights Across the Travel Protection Plans Range
content:
Two deductible figures and one recovery right are scheduled for each Travel Protection Plans plan. The general deductible is the amount withheld from each settlement where the benefit does not name its own. The policy deductible ceiling is the ceiling on the total deductible withheld across all claims on one policy. The recovery right states whether the insurer may recover a settled amount from a liable third party.

| Plan | General deductible for each claim, USD | Ceiling on total deductible per policy, USD | Recovery from a liable third party |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Trip Basics Essential | 100.00 | 300.00 | applies |
| Trip Basics Standard | 75.00 | 225.00 | applies |
| TripGuard Plus | 50.00 | 150.00 | applies |
| TripGuard Premier | 0.00 | 0.00 | applies |
| Cancel For Any Reason Elite | 0.00 | 0.00 | applies |
| Annual Multi-Trip Traveller | 50.00 | 150.00 | applies |
| Annual Multi-Trip Executive | 0.00 | 0.00 | applies |

On the four plans that carry a general deductible, the ceiling on the policy stands at three times that figure: 100.00 against 300.00 on Trip Basics Essential, 75.00 against 225.00 on Trip Basics Standard, and 50.00 against 150.00 on TripGuard Plus and on Annual Multi-Trip Traveller.

Where both figures are 0.00, as on TripGuard Premier, Cancel For Any Reason Elite and Annual Multi-Trip Executive, the plan carries no general deductible and no ceiling above nothing.

The right of recovery from a liable third party applies on all seven plans.
